summary: Tested all 12 features for dual-tone theme on Pharmacy page and category page. All tests PASSED. Pharmacy page has dark top section (#050510), gradient transition (100px), and warm cream light zone (#FFF8F0). Category page has gradient hero header with category image, name, product count, and Back button. Medicine cards have 3D Add to Cart buttons with orange gradient and box-shadow press effect.

issues: Back button z-index (z-10) is same as category info div (z-10), causing Playwright click interception. Functionality works via JS click. Consider increasing Back button z-index to z-20 for better accessibility.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: PharmacyCategory.jsx line 175 - Back button has z-10 but category info div at line 183 also has z-10, causing overlay. Consider z-20 for Back button.

Medicine cards: white background, proper shadows, 3D Add to Cart buttons with active:translate-y-[2px] and active:shadow-none for press effect.
